599:t_027:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the hell is that huge thing!?」

599:t_027:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ネオ・ジオング$$...! So they finished even that!」

599:t_027:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「What an anachronistic name he has given it...!」

599:t_028:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...!」

599:t_028:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You have shown me, $$ガンダム$$. The light of you all.」

599:t_028:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A light that arose from within people... to think that something with this warmth...! How futile...」

599:t_029:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even so, I must do it. That is my mission as the vessel.」

599:t_029:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フロンタル$$! The time has come to settle this!」

599:t_029:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, concentrate your attacks on that psycho machine!」

599:t_029:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If we stop him, the fighting ends! Let's do this!」

599:t_029:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This battle...! We'll make it the last time humans fight each other!」

599:t_029:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The Colonel, who will be king of the abandoned, is the one fit to hold the Box! You ignorant masses who refuse to understand that...! You're all stains! I'll wipe out every last one of you...!」

599:t_030:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even if it ends up halting humanity's progress, I will dare to commit that folly.」

599:t_030:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Wait for me, $$オードリー$$... I will come back to you, no matter what!)

599:t_030:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
(And the future...! I'll find it beyond this fighting!)

599:t_031:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「My mission is not over yet!」

599:t_032:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let you spread the fighting any further!」

599:t_033:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You came, $$バナージ$$! I have been waiting for you, who share my fate as a vessel!」

599:t_033:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're still going on about that!」

599:t_033:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have seen many boys like you... boys who ride a $$ガンダム$$ and work miracles.」

599:t_033:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Miracles, too... repeat. And nothing ever changes.」

599:t_033:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$バナージ$$! Let me show you the Tears of Time!」

599:t_034:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Indeed, our minds had become one.」

599:t_034:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「So that... is what it means to understand each other.」

599:t_035:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...」

599:t_035:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So he entrusted the future to you as well...」

599:t_037:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ is gone now... Go find your own way to live.」

599:t_038:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「All $$ネオ・ジオン$$ units have been destroyed or have retreated.」

599:t_038:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「There's no need to pursue. With $$フル・フロンタル$$ down and most of its strength lost, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ cannot keep fighting.」

599:t_038:4.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... It's about to be disclosed.」

599:t_038:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I'm counting on you, $$オードリー$$.)

599:t_039:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Why!? Why should I be the one to lose!?」

599:t_039:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Stop it already, $$アンジェロ$$!」

599:t_039:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Why is it you!?」

599:t_039:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Why is it you, who never even wished for it, that the Colonel needs!」

599:t_040:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't let it get to you, $$バナージ$$. Following $$フロンタル$$ to the end was his own choice.」

599:t_040:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(So long, $$アンジェロ$$. If you're still alive, then this time find your own way to live with your own strength.)

599:t_041:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So his heart stayed with $$フロンタル$$ to the very end.」

599:t_041:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「A vessel that takes in people's feelings... But if we rely on it, we cannot move forward...」

599:t_042:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We have confirmed the destruction of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

599:t_042:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Not yet! As long as $$フル・フロンタル$$ hasn't shown himself, the battle isn't over!」

599:t_042:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Keep your guard up! We don't know what might still happen!」

599:t_042:3.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(Hurry, $$バナージ$$... The key to this battle is held by you and $$ミネバ$$.)

599:t_043:0.en:
$$ヒル$$
「The $$レウルーラ$$ is...! The $$ネオ・ジオン$$ flagship!!」

599:t_044:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So the $$レウルーラ$$ has fallen.」

599:t_044:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But the fighting won't end until we defeat $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

599:t_044:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ジオン$$, having lost its original principles, ideals and passion, will perish along with that man...」

599:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm sick of your selfish logic! If we left Earth to you, the future would be pitch black!」

599:t_100:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Either way, what awaits humanity's future is darkness. Then choosing a way to live in peace there can be called the right choice.」

599:t_100:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A child like you who knows no fear would surely take my words for mere logic, though.」

599:t_100:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't act like a smart grown-up when you can't even convince one kid!」

599:t_100:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm not handing our future over to a guy like that!」

599:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「We don't want a world made of resignation and compromise...!」

599:t_101:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then do you affirm a world filled with despair and destruction?」

599:t_101:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「You're the one affirming that. We're fighting to avoid such a world.」

599:t_101:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「An optimist who looks away from reality... The dashing fellow everyone talks about seems to be just a romantic.」

599:t_101:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「For someone who's supposed to guide the world, you lack that romance!」

599:t_101:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「A man like that can't carry people's dreams and hopes!」

599:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I always thought you were a weird guy, but becoming a lackey of the Empire? I can't understand that!」

599:t_102:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To a child like you, it would seem so. That is why you should listen to what the adults say here.」

599:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That doesn't mean I think what you're saying is right!」
